issue_context.title: Add anonymized feature tracking for RBAC
issue_context.body:
Please add anonymized usage tracking for RBAC. This will help the Product team answer questions like “What % of clusters are using RBAC?” and improve feature usability and documentation.

- [ ] CREATE ROLE -> `iam.roles.create`
- [ ] CREATE ROLE with NOLOGIN set (new in 20.1) -> `iam.roles.create.nologin`
- [ ] ALTER ROLE (new in 20.1) -> `iam.roles.alter`
- [ ] ALTER ROLE  with NOLOGIN set (new in 20.1) -> `iam.roles.alter.nologin`
- [ ] GRANT <roles> -> `iam.roles.grant{.with_admin}`
- [ ] GRANT <priviliges> -> `iam.roles.privileges.granted.on_{table|database}`
- [ ] SHOW ROLES -> `iam.roles.show`
- [ ] SHOW GRANTS -> `iam.grants.show`
- [ ] DROP ROLE -> `iam.roles.drop`
- [ ] REVOKE <roles> -> `iam.roles.revoke{.with_admin}`
- [ ] REVOKE <priviliges> -> `iam.roles.privileges.revoked`

review_comments: I wonder if there is a way to have a single function to format all of these counter creations. For example, all of these are formatted in the way of "iamroles.operation.type" -- a general function could take in the operation and type to avoid duplicating all of the telemetry.Inc, getCounter and sprintf calls.
I can't really think of a nice way to do this since the functions aren't consistent in their parameters.

The IAM{Alter,Create,Option,Drop} functions all look similar, IAM{Grant,Revoke} look similar, and IAM{Grant,Revoke}Priviledges.

I also wonder if it is possible to these counters up front with "GetCounterOnce", so that we don't have to lock the telemetry map on every call.

Regarding the grouping the functions together - Is there that much value in merging the groups into one function? In this case it'll be difficult to cleanly merge them into one but in my opinion, merging them into 3 separate functions can make it a bit harder to understand. Also the file is fairly small so I think there is some value in having separate functions that are easier to read out at a glance.
